purpose: Independent validation set v3 for the router gate (choice of gate type and threshold only; never trained on). Written by an LLM (Claude Opus 5.5, in Claude Code) from the action definitions (CrouchedTraverse = crouch and pass UNDER the low log bridge; ThreeStepPoleRun = run across the SHORT row of THREE stakes stepping on each; FiveStepPoleRun = same for the LONG row of FIVE stakes) and from the condition categories, without access to the sealed test set. Out-of-scope: unrelated commands, other locomotion / obstacles, wrong use of the same obstacles (on top of the bridge, around the stakes), and ambiguous commands (stakes without a count, no action). Filtered automatically (tools/filter_lang_v3.py) -> instructions_val_v3.json.
